visuals.caption: Chords AB, AC, AD, AE and AF from A: the diameter AD through the center is the longest, and MX is the perpendicular from the center to chord AE.
Two chords AB and CD cross, with perpendiculars MX and MY from the center, segment XY, and angle XMY = 100°.
Two congruent circles with centers N and M; line DA cuts both, with perpendiculars NY and MX and the segment NM.
Equal chords AB and AC with X the midpoint of AB, MY perpendicular to AC, segment XY, and MX and MY extended to D and E.
Triangle ABC inscribed in the circle with equal angles at B and C, X the midpoint of AB, and MY perpendicular to AC.
Chords CD and AB with equal distances MX and MY from the center, and YD = 7 cm.
Equal distances ME and MF from the center, with CD marked (5X + 1) cm, MF marked 2X cm and AB marked 16 cm.
Triangle ABC inscribed in the circle with angle B = 65°, and MD and ME drawn equal to the sides AB and AC.
Two intersecting circles with centres N and M share the point A on line BC, and the line through N and M is parallel to BC.
Two concentric circles with centre M: chords AB and AE of the larger circle cut the smaller circle, and the angles at B and E are equal, with perpendiculars from M to each chord.
Circles N and M meet at A and B, and the line of centres cuts AB at D. MX and MD are equal, NY and ND are equal, and X is the midpoint of chord BC.
Circle with center M, chord AB at 5 cm from M and chord CD at 3 cm from M.
Circle with center M, chord CD of 7 cm and chord AB of 10 cm, each with the perpendicular from M.
Circle with center M and two chords AB and CD, both 8 cm, with the perpendiculars MX and MY drawn to them.
Circle with center M and radius MB = 5 cm; chord AB is 7 cm and chord CD is (X + 1) cm, with perpendiculars ME and MF.
Chords AB and CD with the perpendiculars MX and MY from the center, and dashed radii MA and MC.
Two congruent circles, each with a chord, a perpendicular from the center to its midpoint, and a dashed radius to the chord's end.
Circle with center M, chords AB and CD, and the perpendiculars MX and MY extended to meet the circle at E and O.
Circle with center M, chords AB and CD, perpendiculars MO = 6 cm and ME = (X + 2) cm, and chord CD marked (3X + 4) cm.
